description: This file is a Bash script used for managing a sports telecast database. Its functions include checking database connectivity, running migrations and SQL scripts, resetting the database, showing database status, backing up the database, and command-line interface handling. It contains functions for executing SQL files, managing migration history, and orchestrating database maintenance tasks.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Prints informational messages in green color

methods.name: print_warning
methods.description: Prints warning messages in yellow color

methods.name: print_error
methods.description: Prints error messages in red color

methods.name: check_postgres
methods.description: Checks if PostgreSQL server is accessible

methods.name: run_sql_file
methods.description: Executes a given SQL file against the database

methods.name: create_migration_table
methods.description: Creates a table to track applied migrations

methods.name: is_migration_executed
methods.description: Checks if a specific migration has already been executed

methods.name: record_migration
methods.description: Records the execution status of a migration

methods.name: run_migrations
methods.description: Runs all pending migrations in order

methods.name: reset_database
methods.description: Drops all tables and types in the database to reset it

methods.name: show_status
methods.description: Displays database status, existing tables, migration history, and table row counts

methods.name: backup_database
methods.description: Creates a dump backup of the database

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and environment variables
